items.headline: Nebius Group, Astronics, H&R Block, WhiteFiber And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Wednesday
items.summary: US stocks were higher, Nasdaq up 100 points. Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) shares rose after better-than-expected results. Other big gainers include AII, EROC, ATRO, PESI, CRWV, HRB, CAVA, SMCI, MRX, and White.

items.headline: WhiteFiber Expands AI Infrastructure, Cloud Contracts Exceed $540 Million
items.summary: WhiteFiber reports $28.84 million Q2 revenue, beating estimates as Cloud Services revenue rises 43% and colocation revenue jumps 173%.
